items.title: Cyber Maturity Assessment
items.description: Our comprehensive Cyber Maturity Assessment provides a thorough evaluation of your organization's current cybersecurity posture. We analyze your existing security controls, policies, and procedures to identify gaps and provide actionable recommendations for improvement.
bulletPoints: Comprehensive security posture evaluation across all business units
Gap analysis against industry standards and best practices
Risk prioritization matrix with actionable remediation steps
Detailed reporting with executive summary and technical findings
Follow-up consultation to discuss implementation strategies

items.title: ISO 27001/02 Readiness Review
items.description: Get your organization ready for ISO 27001/27002 certification with our comprehensive readiness review. We assess your current information security management system and provide a clear roadmap to achieve compliance.
bulletPoints: Complete ISMS documentation review and gap analysis
Policy and procedure alignment with ISO 27001/27002 standards
Risk assessment methodology validation and improvement
Internal audit preparation and staff training recommendations
Certification body selection guidance and timeline planning

items.title: IT Audits and Cybersecurity Reviews
items.description: Our expert team conducts thorough IT audits and cybersecurity reviews to ensure your systems meet regulatory requirements and industry standards. We provide detailed findings and practical recommendations.
bulletPoints: Comprehensive IT infrastructure and security controls audit
Compliance assessment against regulatory frameworks
Network security architecture review and recommendations
Data protection and privacy controls evaluation
Detailed audit reports with remediation timelines

items.title: Policy and Procedures
items.description: Establish a robust foundation for your cybersecurity program with our comprehensive policy and procedure development services. We create customized documentation that aligns with your business objectives and regulatory requirements.
bulletPoints: Customized security policy framework development
Procedure documentation aligned with business processes
Employee handbook and training material creation
Regular policy review and update scheduling
Compliance mapping to relevant regulatory standards

items.title: Third-Party Cyber Risk Assessments
items.shortDescription: Assess vendor and partner security risks
items.description: Protect your organization from third-party risks with our comprehensive vendor security assessment program. We evaluate your partners' security posture and provide ongoing monitoring solutions.
bulletPoints: Vendor security questionnaire design and management
On-site security assessments for critical suppliers
Continuous monitoring of third-party security posture
Contract security clause recommendations and reviews
Supply chain risk management program development

items.title: Security Awareness and Training
items.shortDescription: Educate staff on cybersecurity best practices
items.description: Build a security-conscious culture with our comprehensive training programs. We provide engaging, role-based training that helps your employees become your first line of defense against cyber threats.
bulletPoints: Role-based security awareness training programs
Phishing simulation campaigns with detailed reporting
Interactive workshops and hands-on security exercises
Customized training content for your industry and threats
Progress tracking and certification management system

items.title: Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing
items.description: Discover and address security weaknesses before attackers do. Our comprehensive VAPT services combine automated scanning with manual testing to provide thorough security validation.
bulletPoints: Comprehensive network and application vulnerability scanning
Manual penetration testing by certified ethical hackers
Social engineering and physical security assessments
Detailed remediation guidance with proof-of-concept examples
Retesting services to validate security improvements

items.title: PCI DSS Readiness Consulting
items.shortDescription: Prepare your organization for PCI DSS compliance
items.description: Our PCI DSS Readiness Consulting service helps organizations prepare for successful compliance with the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS). We assess your current environment, identify gaps, and provide a clear, actionable roadmap to achieve compliance efficiently.
bulletPoints: Gap Analysis: Understand where your systems and processes fall short of PCI DSS requirements
Risk-Based Recommendations: Prioritize remediation efforts based on business impact and compliance needs
Policy & Process Alignment: Ensure documentation and practices meet PCI DSS standards
Technical Guidance: Support for secure network architecture, encryption, and vulnerability management
Audit Preparation: Equip your team with the evidence and confidence needed for QSA assessments or SAQs

about.title: About Us
about.description: SAFAL Digital is a trusted IT and cybersecurity firm headquartered in Nepal, delivering secure software engineering, resilient web development, and risk-driven cybersecurity solutions. We serve a global client base, including partners in Nepal, the U.S., New Zealand, and Australia, by providing world-class digital services with a strategic cost advantage. Our team is composed of certified security professionals, expert software engineers, and client-focused project managers committed to upholding premier global standards, including ISO 27001, OWASP, and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework.
